summary: Conducted a health survey to assess community knowledge and gauge interest in screenings for diabetes and hypertension.
Delivered a targeted educational session to students on preventing hypertension and diabetes through early, healthy lifestyle choices.
Provided education on cholera prevention, sanitation and food safety, alongside talks on hypertension and healthy living.
Educated students on STIs and cholera, emphasising personal safety to protect their future health.
Held a health talk on the rising risks of hypertension and diabetes among youth driven by lifestyle and eating habits.
Taught students about the risks and prevention of typhoid fever and STIs, highlighting clean water and personal safety.
Spread awareness and shared essential healthcare tips, focused heavily on cholera prevention.
Collaborated with partners to empower students through discussions on reproductive health, science and informed life choices.
Led a menstrual health and hygiene session for girls, featuring the donation and demonstration of sanitary pads.
Provided over 350 students with training in leadership, STEM, reproductive health and practical hygiene.
Partnered with bio-researchers to donate educational materials, food and sanitary supplies to vulnerable children.
Educated students on personal hygiene and malaria prevention, advising against self-medication and unverified remedies.
Organised a municipal health screening with a medical diagnostic centre — testing, health surveys and on-site pharmaceutical care.
